title: Alpha One — Event envelope (EVT-03)
description: Every event carries exactly these fields (EVT-03): id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, payload. The `payload` object is event-specific and defined per event in this directory (each file pins `type` and `version`). Field typing conventions: id/tenant_id = ULID (crockford base32, 26 chars); version = integer (bumped on any payload change, additive-only between freezes); occurred_at = int64 epoch milliseconds, UTC.

currency.description: V1 is USD-only (Out Of Scope: no multi-currency).

correlation_id.description: Request/job correlation id (GW-09/GW-36): every event carries the originating request's X-Correlation-Id; workers mint one at job start. Consumed by the audit mirror (audit_events.correlation_id) and the trace join.
